en.headline: Galaxy Entertainment first-half profit edges up on Macau tourism recovery
en.dek: Net profit rose 0.8 per cent to HK$5.28 billion while revenue increased 4.2 per cent; the group declared an interim dividend of HK$0.90 per share.
body: Galaxy Entertainment Group reported a modest rise in first-half net profit, supported by higher visitor arrivals to Macau and steady demand across its gaming and non-gaming businesses.

For the six months ended 30 June, net profit increased 0.8 per cent year on year to HK$5.28 billion. Revenue rose 4.2 per cent to HK$24.23 billion. Adjusted EBITDA edged up about 1 per cent to roughly HK$7.0 billion.

Chairman Francis Lui said total visitor arrivals to Macau reached 20.9 million in the first half, up 9 per cent from a year earlier. He cited healthy hotel occupancy and sustained demand for both gaming and non-gaming offerings as key supports.

The company declared an interim dividend of HK$0.90 per share, higher than the HK$0.70 paid a year earlier. Cash and liquid investments stood at HK$37.7 billion. Lui said the balance sheet strength would fund the development pipeline and allow continued returns to shareholders.

zh.headline: 銀河娛樂上半年盈利微升0.8% 派中期息0.9元
zh.dek: 受澳門旅客回升帶動，集團錄得淨利潤52.8億元，收入升4.2%；董事會宣佈派發中期股息每股0.9港元。
body: 銀河娛樂集團公布截至6月30日止六個月中期業績，淨利潤按年微升0.8%至52.8億港元，收入升4.2%至242.3億港元。
經調整EBITDA約70億港元，按年升約1%。主席呂耀東表示，上半年訪澳旅客達2090萬人次，按年升9%，酒店入住率理想，博彩及非博彩業務需求持續。
集團宣佈派發中期股息每股0.9港元，高於去年同期的0.7港元，預計9月15日派付。現金及流動投資達377億港元。
呂耀東指財政實力穩健，足以支持發展藍圖、探索海外機遇，並繼續透過股息回饋股東。
